instruction: I keep forgetting to attach files when I mention attachments in my emails. Please enable the attachment reminder feature so Thunderbird warns me if I try to send an email that mentions attachments but has none attached.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling attachment reminder (mail.compose.attachment_reminder=true). Evaluator checks if the preference is set to true. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) from the profile directory
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs properly parses prefs.js using regex and JSON parsing
Expected value 'mail.compose.attachment_reminder=true' is the correct preference for enabling attachment reminder feature
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are written to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 if file is None, handles escaped characters and boolean values correctly
Data flow is logically correct: UI change -> close app -> read prefs file -> verify setting

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
